signalValue.note: Listed on FutureCast early target board

vaultScouting.evaluation: Martenson is a 6-5 / 285 tackle. On the Marist sophomore sit he pancakes the down block, pulls and flattens the linebacker, and leads down the sideline. Pass-protection tape is thin.
vaultScouting.comparison: Martenson comps to Broderick Jones — 6-5 / 311 athletic tackle who can pull, climb, and finish before the pass set is finished product.
vaultScouting.projection: Martenson projects as a Year 1 developmental OL, then he competes for the job in Year 2, with Year 3 starter upside at tackle or guard if the pass set shows up.
strengths: Martenson fires off left tackle, down-blocks, and pancakes the lineman into the turf.
Martenson pulls across the formation, finds the linebacker, and flattens him in the hole.
Martenson pulls from right tackle, gets out in front of the runner, and leads down the sideline.
Martenson keeps his legs churning after contact and finishes through the whistle.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Martenson fits a zone / pull-heavy tackle who can also kick inside — this sit is exclusively tackle, left and right.
